classifications.tested: Passes this repo's integration tests against the provider.
classifications.compatible_by_protocol: The provider documents an S3-compatible API; the generic S3 adapter should work with this preset but is not tested against the provider yet.
classifications.native_planned: No S3 API; needs its own adapter behind the same contract. Not available yet.
classifications.unsupported: No public API reachable by a third-party library.

verification.official_page: The official documentation page was read.
verification.official_search: Only the provider's own pages in search results could be read (the page blocked fetching or is not in English).

providers.name: Amazon S3
providers.caveats: Path-style is supported but scheduled for deprecation; dotted bucket names break virtual-hosted HTTPS.

providers.name: Cloudflare R2
providers.caveats: No ACLs, versioning, bucket policies or object tagging.

providers.name: Wasabi Hot Cloud Storage
providers.region: the bucket's region; the endpoint must match it
providers.caveats: Wrong regional endpoint allows reads but not writes; path-style recommended.

providers.name: Backblaze B2 (S3 Compatible API)
providers.region: the region in the endpoint, e.g. us-east-005
providers.caveats: No object ACLs or object tagging; HTTPS only.

providers.name: DigitalOcean Spaces
providers.region: us-east-1 for signing; the datacenter comes from the endpoint
providers.caveats: No cross-region copy; canned ACLs only.

providers.name: Akamai Object Storage (Linode)
providers.caveats: Legacy cluster endpoints (<cluster>.linodeobjects.com) have lower limits.

providers.name: Vultr Object Storage
providers.region: ignored; the location is in the endpoint
providers.caveats: S3 subset; with gzip, Content-Length may differ from the file size.

providers.name: IBM Cloud Object Storage
providers.region: the location (region, cross-region or single site)
providers.caveats: S3 subset; list returns at most 1,000 per request.

providers.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Object Storage (S3 Compatibility API)
providers.caveats: No object ACLs; virtual-hosted uses the vhcompat host.

providers.name: Google Cloud Storage (XML API interoperability)
providers.region: not documented; use auto or the bucket location
providers.caveats: Operation coverage is not listed on the interoperability page.

providers.name: Alibaba Cloud Object Storage Service (OSS)
providers.caveats: No aws-chunked encoding; new mainland China accounts need a custom domain for data operations.

providers.name: Tencent Cloud Object Storage (COS)
providers.region: the bucket's region; bucket names end in -<appid>
providers.caveats: Newer buckets may not accept path-style.

providers.name: Huawei Cloud Object Storage Service (OBS)
providers.caveats: SigV4 needs unsigned or streaming payload signing; path-style is off in some regions.

providers.name: Hetzner Object Storage
providers.caveats: CopyObject only within one bucket.

providers.name: OVHcloud Object Storage
providers.caveats: Path-style support is not stated.

providers.name: IDrive e2
providers.region: the region code in the account endpoint
providers.caveats: Endpoint is per account; no ACLs.

providers.name: Storj S3 Compatible Gateway
providers.caveats: ListMultipartUploads is partial; no ACLs or bucket policies.

providers.name: Tigris Object Storage
providers.caveats: Virtual-hosted addressing required; no PutBucketVersioning.

providers.name: Supabase Storage (S3 protocol)
providers.caveats: S3 must be enabled in the project; access keys bypass row-level security; no versioning or tagging.

providers.name: MinIO
providers.region: us-east-1 unless the server sets one
providers.caveats: Path-style by default; virtual-hosted needs a server domain setting; no ACLs.

providers.name: Ceph Object Gateway
providers.caveats: Virtual-hosted needs rgw_dns_name and a wildcard certificate.

providers.name: Garage
providers.region: the s3_region in the server config
providers.caveats: No versioning, ACLs or bucket policies.

providers.name: SeaweedFS S3 API
providers.region: us-east-1 unless the server sets one
providers.caveats: Virtual-hosted needs a domain setting and wildcard DNS.

providers.name: Azure Blob Storage
providers.auth: shared key, SAS or Microsoft Entra ID
providers.caveats: Block uploads instead of multipart; copy can be asynchronous; search by tags only.

providers.name: Google Drive
providers.caveats: Files are addressed by id, not path; names are not unique within a folder.

providers.name: Microsoft OneDrive and SharePoint (Microsoft Graph)
providers.caveats: Items by id or /root:/path; personal, business and site drives differ.

providers.name: Dropbox
providers.caveats: Content transfers use content.dropboxapi.com.

providers.name: Box
providers.caveats: Uploads use upload.box.com; large files need chunked upload.

providers.name: Apple iCloud Drive
providers.caveats: Apple documents only on-device access (the iCloud Drive folder and app ubiquity containers on Apple platforms) and CloudKit for an app's own data; no public API for a user's iCloud Drive files from other platforms. Apps reach it as local files on Apple devices.
